scope: owner-directed std30.wav only; no 32-file mode and no corpus WER claim

machine.cpu: 4x Cortex-A76 up to 2.256 GHz + 4x Cortex-A55 up to 1.8 GHz
machine.npu: 3-core RK3588 NPU through the proprietary RKNPU2 stack

fp16.note: precompiled RKNPU2 graph uses float16 tensor I/O

q8_0.note: GGML q8_0 is rejected as an invalid Toolkit2 2.3.2 quantized_dtype; native w8a8 also quantizes activations and requires calibration, so it is not relabeled

q5_0.note: Toolkit2 2.3.2 has no native RK3588 5-bit graph-conversion mode

q4_K.note: Toolkit2 2.3.2 has no native RK3588 groupwise GGML q4_K graph-conversion mode

q4_0.note: Toolkit2 2.3.2 rejects q4_0; its distinct w4a16 mode is also unsupported on RK3588

w4a16_runtime_probe.format: symmetric INT4 weights, group size 32, FP16 activations and FP16 output
w4a16_runtime_probe.package_validation: passed: 202 encoder and 41 decoder W4 tensors
w4a16_runtime_probe.official_sdk_positive_control: FP16 x FP16, M=1 K=64 N=64: passed
w4a16_runtime_probe.official_sdk_w4a16: rknn_matmul_create returned -5: RKNN_FLOAT16_MM_INT4_TO_FLOAT16 unsupported on this platform
w4a16_runtime_probe.baseline: rejected at context creation before NPU dispatch
w4a16_runtime_probe.llmc: rejected at context creation before NPU dispatch
w4a16_runtime_probe.reason: Rockchip upstream 2.3.2 documents W4A16 for RK3576; RK3588 documents INT4 x INT4 to INT16 only

custom_w4_fp16_system_path.cpu_role: unpack INT4 and apply group scales into aligned FP16 output-column shards
custom_w4_fp16_system_path.scheduler: three independent contexts pinned to Core0, Core1 and Core2; 16-aligned N sharding
custom_w4_fp16_system_path.combined_mask_result: Core0+1 and Core0+1+2 rejected with -1; RKNN_NPU_CORE_ALL executes on one core
custom_w4_fp16_system_path.quality: baseline and LLMC generated identical 87-token sequences on std30.wav

native_toolkit_checks.w8a8: configuration accepted; not benchmarked because no calibrated large-v3-turbo graph was produced
native_toolkit_checks.w16a16i: configuration accepted; not a PDF weight variant
native_toolkit_checks.w16a16i_dfp: configuration accepted; not a PDF weight variant

methodology.baseline: community Python runner using RKNPU2 for all model operators; host-copy encoder and decoder KV path (--no-zero-copy-decoder); ondemand CPU, rknpu_ondemand NPU and dmc_ondemand memory governors
methodology.llmc: Python-free C++17 target runtime using the RKNPU2 C API; DMA-BUF encoder KV handoff; in-place self-KV; selective cache synchronization; all-core NPU mask; taskset 4-7; CPU/NPU/DMC performance governors during the run
methodology.encoder: time from synchronized fixed-30-second feature input through encoder rknn_run completion
methodology.decoder: mean over 80 RKNPU2 decoder steps (4 prompt plus 76 generated-token follow-up steps)
methodology.end_to_end: inference path from WAV read and feature extraction through final EOT; model loading excluded
methodology.quality: exact transcript comparison on std30.wav; no reference corpus was run
methodology.repeat_policy: one baseline; three adjacent best-profile LLMC runs of the same std30.wav; report the LLMC median

llmc_median.governors: CPU/NPU/DMC performance during measurement; restored after each battery

llmc.runner: native C++17 custom W4-to-FP16 runtime with resident decoder B shards

native_auto_core_ondemand.decision: keep native zero-copy, continue NPU-core tuning

kept: pure C++17 inference runtime with no Python dependency
DMA-BUF import of both 15.36 MB encoder KV outputs into the decoder context
in-place 4.59 MB key and value self-cache bindings across decoder steps
disabled global input/output cache flushes with explicit sync only for features, token, position and logits
Cortex-A76 affinity plus CPU, NPU and DMC performance governors during measurement
optimization.restoration: all three governors returned to ondemand/rknpu_ondemand/dmc_ondemand after each tuned battery

quality.result: baseline and all five native tuning/final runs produced the same 77-token English transcript

exploratory_open_stack_appendix.status: not used for the proprietary RKNPU2 headline or cross-device row
exploratory_open_stack_appendix.reason_retained: records the earlier feasibility work and exact PDF GGML formats
